deployment_scope: outputs/insights：Idea Detail + Evidence Group + Evidence Item + Failure Case + Raw Source + Failure Explorer
evidence_ui_policy: Raw Source, Evidence Extraction and AI Analysis are separate; each Claim carries support relation and evidence status
evidence_gate: Only verified real Raw Sources may support Claims; AI-generated evidence is forbidden; only Verified counts as Radar Hit
retrieval_policy: All queries, candidates, selections, rejections and reasons are retained
deep_link_policy: Only provenance-ready ideas with Medium/High Evidence Confidence are eligible for Weekly Top10; all pages must return HTTP 200
